City Council & Successor Agency Regular Meeting
AGENDA
la puente City Council & Successor Agency Regular Meeting
COUNCIL CHAMBERS
15900 EAST MAIN STREET, LA PUENTE
AUGUST 14, 2012
7:00
P.M.
CALL TO ORDER
ROLL CALL
COUNCIL MEMBERS/AGENCY BOARD MEMBERS: Holloway, Klinakis, Argudo, House, and Lewis
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
PRESENTATIONS - None.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
If you wish to address the City Council on an item other than a public hearing matter, please complete the Request for Oral Presentation form and submit it to the City Clerk no later than prior to the conclusion of the first speaker’s remarks. (Ordinance No. 06-843).
RECESS THE SUCCESSOR AGENCY
BOARDS/COMMISSION/COMMITTEE REPORTS
A.
MINUTES OF PREVIOUS CITY COUNCIL MEETING
A-1
READ AND APPROVE THE MINUTES OF THE REGULAR MEETING OF JUNE 12, 2012
It is recommended that the City Council waive the reading and approve the Minutes of the Regular Meeting of June 12, 2012.
A-1 CC. Minutes 06-12-12
B.
PUBLIC HEARING BEFORE THE CITY COUNCIL
B-1
CONSIDERATION OF A RESOLUTION TO SELF-CERTIFY COMPLIANCE WITH THE LOCAL LOS ANGELES COUNTY CONGESTION MANAGEMENT PROGRAM GUIDELINES
It is recommended that the City Council approve and adopt the resolution certifying that that city is in compliance with the 2010 CMP, adopting the 2012 CMP Local Development Report ad direct the City Clerk to forward a certified copy of said resolution to the Los Angeles County Metropolitan Transportation Authority.
B-1 CC. Staff Report - Congestion Management
B-1 CC. Resolution Attachment A -CMP 2012 Conformity
B-1 CC. Attachment B-CMP 2012 LDR Form
E.
NEW BUSINESS TO BE CONSIDERED BY THE CITY COUNCIL
E-4
DISCUSS AND PROVIDE DIRECTION REGARDING LOS ANGELES COUNTY SHERIFF BADGES (City Manager to provide verbal report at Council meeting)
It is recommended that the City Council discuss and provide staff direction.
E-1
LEAGUE OF CALIFORNIA CITIES DESIGNATION OF VOTING DELEGATE FOR ANNUAL CONFERENCE
It is recommended that the Mayor and City Council appoint a voting delegate and up to two alternates, and direct the City Clerk to forward the Voting Delegate/Alternate Form to the League of California Cities.
E-1 CC. Staff Report League of CA Cities-Delegates
E-1 CC. Attachment A -League of CA Cities-Delegates
E-1 CC. Attachment B - Voting Procedures
E-1 CC. Attachment C - Voting Form
E-2
APPROVAL OF A RESOLUTION FOR AN ADVANCE FROM THE CITY OF LA PUENTE TO THE SUCCESSOR AGENCY OF THE FORMER LA PUENTE COMMUNITY DEVELOPMENT COMMISSION FOR PAYMENT OF OUTSTANDING PASS-THROUGH AGREEMENTS IN THE AMOUNT OF $43,193.49 AS REQUIRED UNDER AB 1484
It is recommended that the Council adopt a Resolution approving an advance from the City of La Puente to the Successor Agency of the former La Puente Community Development Commission for payment of outstanding pass-through agreements in the amount of $43,193.49 as required under AB 1484.
E-2 CC. Staff Report Fin Outstanding Pass-Through Payments
E-2 CC. Attachment A, Resolution Fin Advance to SA -
E-2 CC. Attachment B - Loan Agreement
E-3
DISCUSS AND PROVIDE DIRECTION REGARDING THE HEALTHY EATING ACTIVE LIVING PROGRAM (Council Member Lewis)
E-5
CONSIDERATION OF ONE PLANNING COMMISSION APPOINTMENT
It is recommended that Mayor Pro Tem Klinakis appoint a member to the Planning Commission.
E-5 CC. - PC Appointment
E-5 CC. Attachment A - Ordiance No. 11-913
E-6
CONSIDERATION OF MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING WITH UNITED. STATES SPECIALTY INSURANCE COMPANY ("USSIC") FOR THE COMPLETION OF THE PUENTE CREEK NATURE EDUCATION CENTER CONSTRUCTION PROJECT. (Attachment- A, MOU report to follow)
It is recommended that the City Council approve the MOU between the City and USSIC for completion of the Puente Creek Nature Education Center.
E-6 CC. Staff Report Nature Center MOU
E-6 MOU Nature Center agreement
E-7
DISCUSS AND PROVIDE DIRECTION REGARDING THE 2012 MAIN STREET RUN
It is recommended that the City Council discuss and provide staff direction.
E-7 CC. Staff Report - Main Street Run 2012
E-8
CONSIDERATION OF A RESOLUTION ADOPTING CITY COUNCIL POLICY CC - 5.1, OFFICIAL CITY APPAREL FOR COUNCILMEMBERS AND PLANNING COMMISSIONERS
It is recommended that the City Council approve City Council Policy CC-5.1, Official City Apparel for Councilmembers and Planning Commissioners by approving and adopting the Resolution.
E-8 CC. Staff Report Offical City Apparel
E-8 CC. Attahcment A Resolution Apparel Policy
E-8 CC. Exhibit - A, City Apparel Policy
RECESS THE CITY COUNCIL AND RECONVENE THE SUCCESSOR AGENCY
A.
MINUTES OF PREVIOUS SUCCESSOR AGENCY MEETING - None.
B.
PUBLIC HEARINGS - None.
C.
UNFINISHED BUSINESS - None.
D.
CONSENT CALENDAR - None.
C.
UNFINISHED BUSINESS OF THE CITY COUNCIL
C-1
CONSIDERATION OF A RESOLUTION ADOPTING COUNCIL POLICIES CC - 2.1, TRAVEL EXPENSE REIMBURSEMENT AND RESCINDING RESOLUTION 08-4738
It is recommended that the City Council approve the Council Policy CC-2.1, Travel Expense Reimbursement and adopting the Resolution.
C-1 CC. Admin Staff Report-Travel Expense Reimbursement Policy
C-1 CC. Attachment A Resolution Travel Policy
C-1 CC. Attachment B- Discussion Topics Relating To Travel)
C-1 CC. Attachment C Travel Expense Reimbursement Policy (Forms)
C-1 CC. Attachment D -Travel Expense Reimbursement Policy - Travel Agreement)
C-1 CC. Exhibit A Travel Policy (2)
C-2
DISCUSS AND PROVIDE DIRECTION ON FINANCIAL ADVISORY SERVICES FOR THE PROPOSED ISSUANCE OF REFUNDING BONDS
It is recommended that the City Council discuss and provide staff direction.
F.
CLOSED SESSION
F-1
THE CITY COUNCIL WILL RECESS TO CLOSED SESSION PURSUANT TO GOVERNMENT CODE 54957.6(f) TO CONFERENCE WITH LABOR NEGOTIATORS.  AGENCY DESIGNATED REPRESENTATIVES:  BRET M. PLUMLEE, CITY MANAGER; WARD KOMERS, DIRECTOR OF ADMINISTRATIVE SERVICES; AND JAY TRINNAMAN, COUNSEL.  EMPLOYEE ORGANIZATIONS: CEA AND SEIU
RECONVENE TO OPEN SESSION
REPORT FROM CLOSED SESSION
ADHOC COMMITTEE REPORTS
AB 1234 REPORTS
REPORT FROM CLOSED SESSION
D.
CITY COUNCIL CONSENT CALENDAR
All matters listed under Consent Calendar are considered to be routine in nature and may be enacted by one motion approving the recommendation listed on the Agenda. One or more items may be removed from the Consent Calendar so that said item(s) may be discussed and considered individually by the City Council, if a motion to remove the item(s) is approved by an affirmative vote of a majority of the members of the City Council. Those specific item(s) will be considered as the first item under New Business.
D-1
CONSIDERATION OF A RESOLUTION APPROVING WARRANT REGISTER NO. 1323 FOR FISCAL YEAR 2011 - 12 AND FISCAL YEAR 2012-2013
It is recommended that the City Council adopt the Resolution approving Warrant Register No. 1323.
D-1 WR# 1323
E.
NEW BUSINESS TO BE CONSIDERED BY THE SUCCESSOR AGENCY
E-1
APPROVAL OF A RESOLUTION FOR AN ADVANCE FROM THE CITY OF LA PUENTE TO THE SUCCESSOR AGENCY OF THE FORMER LA PUENTE COMMUNITY DEVELOPMENT COMMISSION FOR PAYMENT OF OUTSTANDING PASS-THROUGH AGREEMENTS IN THE AMOUNT OF $43,193.49 AS REQUIRED UNDER AB 1484"
It is recommended that the City Council adopt a Resolution approving an advance from the City of La Puente to the Successor Agency of the former La Puente Community Development Commission for payment of outstanding pass-through agreements in the amount of $43,193.49 as required under AB 1484.
E-1 SA. Staff Report Loan Agreement AB 1484 Payment
E-1 SA. Resolution Pass-Through Payments
E-1 SA Attachment B Loan Agreement
ADJOURN THE SUCCESSOR AGENCY, RECONVENE THE CITY COUNCIL AND RECESS CITY COUNCIL INTO CLOSED SESSION
ADHOC COMMITTEE REPORTS
AB 1234 REPORTS
ORAL COMMENTS FROM COUNCIL
ORAL COMMENTS FROM STAFF
ADJOURNMENT - TO AUGUST 16, 2012 AT 1:30 P.M. IN THE COUNCIL CHAMBERS AND THE CITY COUNCIL WILL RECESS TO CLOSED SESSION PURSUANT TO GOVERNMENT CODE 54957 FOR A PUBLIC EMPLOYEE PERFORMANCE EVALUATION (TITLE: CITY MANAGER)
AVAILABILITY
Any writings or documents provided to a majority of the City Council regarding any item on this agenda will be made available for public inspection at the City Clerk Department at City Hall located at 15900 E Main Street and the Reference Desk at the Library located at 15920 E. Central during normal business hours. In addition, such writings and documents will be posted on the City's website at http://www.lapuente.org
AMERICANS WITH DISABILITIES
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, if you need special assistance to participate in a City meeting or other services offered by the City, please contact the City Clerk's Office at (626) 855-1500. Notification at least 48 hours prior to the meeting or time when services are needed will assist City staff in assuring that reasonable arrangements can be made to provide accessibility to the meeting or service.
MEETING TIMES
Meetings of the City Council shall be adjourned no later than 10:30 p.m., unless a motion to supersede the 10:30 time limit to consider some or all of the remaining items listed on the Agenda, or to consider items which have been added to the Agenda in accordance with the provisions of the Ralph M. Brown Act, Government Code Section 54950, et seq., is approved by a majority of the members of the City Council. (Ordinance No. 95-727).
CERTIFICATION
I hereby certify under penalty of perjury, under the laws of the State of California that the foregoing agenda was posted in accordance with the applicable legal requirements.
Dated this 10th day of August, 2012.
______________________________________
Pat Jacquez-Nares, CMC, City Clerk

REGULAR MEETING OF
August 14, 2012
A Regular Meeting of the City Council & Successor Agency Regular Meeting of the City of La Puente was held in the Council Chambers of City Hall, 15900 East Main Street, La Puente, California, on August 14, 2012, at 7:00 p.m.

Vince House moved to approve the Minutes of the Regular Meeting of June 12, 2012.; seconded by Charlie Klinakis.
The motion unanimously carried by the following roll call vote: AYES: Charlie Klinakis, Vince House, David Argudo, Dan Holloway, and Violeta Lewis. NOES: None.

The motion unanimously carried by the following roll call vote: AYES: Charlie Klinakis, Vince House, David Argudo, Dan Holloway, and Violeta Lewis. NOES: None.

The motion unanimously carried by the following roll call vote: AYES: Charlie Klinakis, Vince House, David Argudo, Dan Holloway, and Violeta Lewis. NOES: None.
